performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; organic GBP cliff and 5 overdue SOW milestones demand resolution now.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta $0, Google $0 — means ROAS and purchase data are structurally absent; no efficiency verdict is possible.
5 SOW milestones overdue (latest Aug 31): Live-Cooking Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM, SEO Phase 1 — blocking paid re-launch.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Aug 30–31 (vs. 8–40 range prior 26 days) and -50.97% week-over-week — 3-day signal confirms a real drop, not noise.
GA4 sessions averaged 338/day (Aug 22–28 prior 3) vs 337/day (Aug 29–Sep 1 last 3) — flat trend; site traffic holding despite GBP cliff, suggesting direct/bookmarked visits.
28-day Shopify shows 0 purchases and $0 revenue despite 7,570 GA4 sessions and 3,338 reported conversions — attribution disconnect; Windsor reconciliation outstanding.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; paid re-launch is blocked until Funnel Test + UTM go live.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW deliverables missed their Aug 31 deadline: Live-Cooking Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails. Paid media (Meta ~$1,000–1,500/mo budgeted) cannot responsibly reactivate while the funnel test is open and UTM tracking is unconfirmed, per the attribution frame documented in the engagement plan. Success check: all 5 items marked complete in Monday by 2026-09-09. Nacer (Ops) owns resolution; Sohib to confirm status by EOD 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP 0-action days Aug 30–31; verify listing status and check for a suspension or edit-lock event.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on Aug 30 and Aug 31, after averaging 25+ actions/day Aug 22–29 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not seasonal noise. Check Google Business Profile dashboard for any suspension notice, pending verification, or recent category/address edit that triggered a review lock. Success check: GBP actions return above 15/day within 3 days of any corrective action. Re-check 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions and GBP recovery through Sep 5; do not reactivate paid spend until F2 milestones are cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions are holding flat (~337/day last 3 days) with zero paid support, which is a stable baseline to launch from — but not a signal to spend yet. Paid re-launch requires: (1) Funnel Test closed and UTM confirmed live, (2) GBP listing confirmed healthy, (3) at least one creative batch from the facility footage (July 21 Drive folders) approved. Check all three conditions on 2026-09-09 before any budget is activated.
